messages:
Rina: Cloud marketplace partner in APAC reports regressed throughput after our marketplace images moved from CUDA/ROCm pinned drivers. They saw ~25% drop. Tagging infra + vendor.
Omar: Which image and driver versions? Need exact tags to reproduce.
Rina: Image: `redwood/llm-runtime:cuda12.3-rocm5.6-2026-03-21`, kernel 6.4.8, nvidia 535 / amdgpu 6.1. Partner run: `./serve_bench --batch 8 --seq 512`. No crashes.
Vik: Possible causes: kernel module param change, BLAS fallback, or changed kernel LRU behavior. Also check udev firmware and memory cgroup pressure.
infra-bot: CI alert: `marketplace-e2e (rocm5.6)` throughput test failed: 310 req/s vs baseline 420 req/s. p99 increased from 260ms -> 480ms.
Jules: Quick mitigation option: publish a compat image that pins older driver modules (`amdgpu=6.0.0`, `nvidia=532`) but keeps users on the same runtime libs. That avoids app changes.
Omar: If we publish compat image, we must run smoke E2E and schedule 24h canary. I'll prepare CI job.
cw-vendor: Vendor note: recent amdgpu changes in 6.x kernels altered prefetch heuristics; a driver micro-release is in progress but ETA ~2 weeks.
Rina: Plan: (1) Omar build `rocm-5.6-compat` with pinned module versions + smoke tests (ETA 3h) (2) Vik run perf trace against partner repro and validate hipBLAS on device (ETA 2h) (3) Jules draft partner advisory and rollback plan (ETA 1h).
Omar: Starting build now. Posting progress in thread.
Vik: Will also check KV-cache eviction and batching behavior; if it's eviction-driven we might tune allocator flags instead of rollback.
Rina: Thanks. Marking priority P2. Will update partner once we have canary results.
